caption: The drawing depicts two views of a metal object, both rendered in shades of brown, gray, and black. The larger, main object at the bottom of the image is a circular, shallow dish or tray with a vertical cylindrical support rising from its center. Mounted atop the support is a semi-cylindrical basin or cup, which is open at the top and has a squared section at one end that appears to be a hinge or bracket. This upper structure is metallic, with darker areas indicating depth and shadow. Above and to the left of the main object, there is a simplified side view of the same apparatus, also showing the circular base but with more emphasis on the horizontal and semi-cylindrical parts at the top. Both objects are drawn against a plain, light beige background. The words "MILTON DEVICE" are printed in small, uppercase letters below the main illustration.
title: Betty Lamp
